beats.child_action: One-finger bag-to-bowl gesture requests Roshan's travel and pour.
beats.visible_change: flour fills the same mixing bowl
beats.contact: Roshan carries and tips the bag over the bowl

beats.child_action: One-finger presses and folds guide the kneading action.
beats.visible_change: rough dough becomes smooth dough along the hand path
beats.contact: Roshan's hand meets the same dough

beats.child_action: One-finger shaping follows the pictured loaf outline with generous tolerance.
beats.visible_change: the same raw dough portion takes the pictured loaf shape
beats.line: Make the loaf look like this.
beats.pointer: one pictured order and raw dough
beats.contact: Roshan shapes and places the same raw dough on its tray

beats.child_action: One finger requests tray placement and oven closure, then guided holds or taps on the pictured oven control advance baking; idle input pauses it.
beats.visible_change: Roshan loads the raw loaf, closes the oven and visibly bakes that same loaf in response to intentional input
beats.line: Put the tray in. Help the oven bake.
beats.pointer: tray, oven shelf, then pictured oven control
beats.contact: Roshan supports the tray at the oven shelf and operates its door/control; no burn or lost loaf

beats.child_action: A deliberate one-finger oven-to-cooling-place gesture requests removal; no automatic retrieval.
beats.visible_change: the same visibly baked loaf leaves the oven and rests on the cooling place
beats.line: Use the mitt. Take the bread out.
beats.pointer: oven mitt, tray handle and cooling place
beats.contact: Roshan's mitted hand meets the tray handle and carries it to the supported cooling place

beats.child_action: A deliberate one-finger loaf-to-plate gesture requests delivery.
beats.visible_change: the retrieved baked loaf reaches the matching pictured plate
beats.line: Bring the bread to this plate.
beats.contact: Roshan carries and places that same baked loaf
